data.notes: November’s confirmed music calendar is currently anchored by Ischgl’s official winter-opening Top of the Mountain concert; the 2026 artist lineup has not yet been announced.

events.title: Top of the Mountain Opening Concert
events.summary: Ischgl’s official Top of the Mountain Opening Concert is confirmed for 28 November 2026 at the Silvrettabahn car park. The official event page lists the 2026 artist details as “Coming soon,” so no headliner is confirmed yet.
